items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: We used to call him Yankee.

ctx.x: We used to call him Yankee. I'll tell you what I know because we're bummed again. Mm-hmm. Yeah. But Tio would get rough. Rough is the next one to get if he wanted. This will even go.
And rough is a cop, huh?
